title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the acceleration during taxiing as 2 m/s².

title: Taxiing time
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the taxiing time as 40 s.

title: Energy increase magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the increase in mechanical energy of the water as 2.8 × 10⁷ J.

title: Kinematics reasoning
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply kinematic equations for uniformly accelerated motion from rest.

title: Mechanical energy definition
description: Important Criteria: The solution must define the change in mechanical energy as the sum of kinetic and potential energy changes.

title: Correct energy reference points
description: Important Criteria: The calculation must use the correct initial (v₁, h=0) and final (v₂, h=100 m) states for the water's energy.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All intermediate steps and final answers should include correct SI units.

title: Sign error in energy
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student subtracts the final kinetic or potential energy instead of adding them.

title: Incorrect kinematic formula
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect kinematic relation (e.g., v₁ = at without averaging for distance).
